the most important Alternaria toxin in tomatoes is tenuazonic, followed by alternariol and alternarol monomethyl ethers.
tenuazonic and tentoxin were the most frequently occurring toxins in tomatoes and tomato-based products, whereas alternariol and alternarol methyl ether were found in much lower concentrations.
